name: NIGHTSHIFT with Paul Day + Matos
description: Kick off the weekend early at one of Porto's most popular clubs. Plano B hosts an evening of quality electronic music to get you on the dance floor.
longDescription:
NIGHTSHIFT returns to Plano B on August 6, 2026, presenting an evening of electronic music featuring sets from Paul Day and Matos. This event is part of Plano B's ongoing programming, which regularly showcases both local and international DJs within the electronic music scene. The NIGHTSHIFT series focuses on delivering curated selections for an audience interested in dance-oriented sounds.

Attendees can expect a club atmosphere conducive to dancing, with the music serving as the central focus. Plano B is known for its multi-room layout, offering different sonic environments throughout the night. The event typically runs into the early hours, attracting a crowd primarily interested in nightlife and electronic music culture.

This is a ticketed event. Plano B is located in downtown Porto, easily accessible via public transport. The venue is a short walk from Aliados metro station.
